summary: Wearable Devices Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting that on September 10, 2026 its board approved increasing the ordinary shares reserved under the 2024 Global Equity Incentive Plan by 753,788, from 433,952 to 1,187,740. No price, premium, stake or deal terms are stated. The filing is incorporated by reference into the company's Form S-8 and Form F-3 registration statements. This is a routine equity-plan reserve increase, not a special situation; the only angle to watch is potential dilution and any related share-count overhang.
